support.quote: The Greenland shark has the longest known lifespan of all vertebrates.

assessments.note: Same page: oldest individual 392 ± 120 years, i.e. 272–512 (lead rounds to 272–510).

support.quote: The largest shark they found, a 5-meter female, was between 272 and 512 years old according to their estimates.
This number is also in line with the most recent five-year annual global average of eight unprovoked fatalities per year.
